title: 第21章 宴席风云第22章 玄脉重续
content_zh:
林远山不愧是经营天香阁多年的老狐狸，很快调整好情绪，脸上重新堆起笑容：果然是虎父无犬子！
今日一见，谁还敢说尘少爷是废物？
他话锋一转，
不过事情闹到这个地步，尘少爷究竟意欲何为？
叶霄尘眨了眨眼睛，一脸无辜：来天香阁还能干什么？当然是吃饭啊。
杀人、打伤我林家公子，尘少爷还觉得能安心用膳？林远山皮笑肉不笑地问道。
不过处置了个细作罢了，收拾干净就好。
叶霄尘随意地摆摆手，
至于这位玉堂少爷，年纪轻轻就这般跋扈，迟早要吃亏。
今日让他长个记性，明白这世上不是谁都会惯着他。
林远山眼角抽了抽：玉堂虽不成器，但毕竟是族长大哥的爱子。
想来族长大人一定会...非常感激尘少爷的教诲。
他强压怒火，
现在可否先放了玉堂？再这样下去，他怕是要不行了。
当然可以。
叶霄尘爽快道，
叶青，把咱们的玉堂少爷完好无损地送回去。
记住，可别磕着碰着了。
叶青应声，像拎死狗一样将奄奄一息的林玉堂提起来，粗暴地塞给林远山。
刚脱离魔掌，林玉堂眼中立刻闪过怨毒之色，正要开口，却听叶霄尘幽幽道：玉堂少爷，我这人胆子小。

若是再听到什么威胁的话...
他露出一个令人毛骨悚然的笑容，我可是会当真的。
林玉堂顿时如坠冰窟，到嘴边的话硬生生咽了回去。
还不快带少爷去疗伤！
林远山厉声呵斥侍从，又吩咐道：把这里收拾干净！
一具尸体摆在这儿，还让不让人吃饭了？
待一切处理妥当，林远山勉强挤出笑容：今日扫了尘少爷雅兴，这顿饭就算在林某账上。
这多不好意思啊...
叶霄尘嘴上推辞，身体却很诚实地坐回座位，像个占了便宜的孩子般朝苏晚晴炫耀：
苏姨你看，长得帅就是有好处，出门都有人请吃饭！
转头对叶青叶龙道：今天敞开了吃！
林远山冷眼旁观，心中惊疑不定。
眼前这个少年时而天真如赤子，时而狠辣如恶魔，还有种超乎年龄的老练与妖异。
最令他不安的是——这个公认的废物，真的不能修炼吗？
待林远山离开后，天香阁的侍者们很快将现场打扫得一尘不染。
叶霄尘惬意地靠在椅背上，指尖轻叩桌面。
他知道林玉堂身边必有王家安插的眼线——有时候一个下人的无心之言，就足以影响主子的判断。
少主为何不直接...叶青做了个抹脖子的动作。
叶霄尘摇摇头：我叶霄尘向来以理服人。
content_en:
Lin Yuanshan is worthy of being an old fox who has been running Tianxiang Pavilion for many years. He quickly adjusted his mood and put a smile on his face again: It turns out that the tiger father has no dog son!
After seeing him today, who would dare to say that Master Chen is a waste?
He changed the subject,
But when things have reached this point, what exactly does Master Chen want to do?
Ye Xiaochen blinked his eyes with an innocent look on his face: What else could he do in Tianxiang Pavilion? Of course it's to eat.
After killing people and injuring me, Mr. Lin, Master Chen still thinks he can eat in peace? Lin Yuanshan asked with a smile.
But it's just a matter of detail, just clean it up.
Ye Xiaochen waved his hands casually,
As for this young master of Yutang, he is so domineering at such a young age and will suffer consequences sooner or later.
Let him have a good memory today and understand that not everyone in this world will spoil him.
Lin Yuanshan's eyes twitched: Although Yutang is useless, he is the beloved son of the clan eldest brother after all.
I think the patriarch will be...very grateful to Master Chen for his teachings.
He suppressed his anger,
Can you let Yutang go now? If this continues, he may die.
sure.
Ye Xiaochen said cheerfully,
Ye Qing, send our Young Master Yutang back intact.
Remember, don't bump into each other.
Ye Qing responded, lifted up the dying Lin Yutang like a dead dog, and roughly handed him to Lin Yuanshan.
As soon as he escaped from the clutches of the devil, Lin Yutang's eyes immediately flashed with resentment. Just as he was about to speak, he heard Ye Xiaochen say quietly: "Master Yutang, I am a timid person."
If I hear any more threats...
He gave me a creepy smile that I took seriously.
Lin Yutang suddenly felt like he had fallen into an ice cave, and he swallowed the words that came to his lips.
Why don't you take the young master to heal his wounds quickly!
Lin Yuanshan scolded the attendants sharply, and then ordered: Clean up this place!
With a corpse lying here, why don't you let anyone eat?
After everything was settled, Lin Yuanshan forced out a smile: I swept away Master Yaxing today, and this meal will be credited to Lin's account.
How embarrassing...
Ye Xiaochen declined, but sat back down in his seat honestly, showing off to Su Wanqing like a child who had taken advantage:
Look, Aunt Su, being handsome has its benefits. People treat you to dinner when you go out!
Turning to Ye Qingyelong, he said: "It's open to eat today!"
Lin Yuanshan watched with cold eyes, feeling shocked and confused.
The young man in front of him is sometimes as innocent as a child, sometimes as ruthless as a devil, and he also has a sophistication and eccentricity beyond his years.
What made him most uneasy was - could this recognized waste really be unable to practice?
After Lin Yuanshan left, the waiters at Tianxiang Pavilion quickly cleaned the scene spotlessly.
Ye Xiaochen leaned back on the chair comfortably and tapped his fingertips on the table.
He knew that there must be an informant from the Wang family around Lin Yutang - sometimes a servant's unintentional words could be enough to affect his master's judgment.
Young Master, why don't you just... Ye Qing made a gesture of wiping his neck.
Ye Xiaochen shook his head: I, Ye Xiaochen, have always convinced people with reason.
